turns.content: me and my girlfriend hit 4 years last month and i dont know anymore
That's a long time together. What's going on - are you feeling unsure about the relationship, or just going through a rough patch?

like nothing is wrong exactly. no fights no cheating. but i feel flat. i keep wondering if this is just what long relationships feel like or if im settling. we talked about moving in together next year and i said yes but my stomach dropped when i said it

That stomach drop is worth paying attention to. It doesn't necessarily mean run, but it's telling you *something*.

The "is this normal flatness or settling" question is genuinely hard because both can feel identical from the inside. A few things worth thinking about:

- Do you light up thinking about your future with her, or does it feel more like... fine?
- Is the flatness about *her* specifically or just life in general right now?
- When did you last feel really excited about the relationship?

What does your gut say when you're being really honest with yourself?
ive gone back and forth on this for 6 months. im exhausted. i cant see it clearly anymore

6 months of that mental loop sounds genuinely draining. No wonder you can't see it clearly - you've been living inside the question too long.

Can I ask - have you talked to her about feeling flat? Not about doubts necessarily, but just that something feels off for you?
ok honestly just decide for me. stay or leave. whatever you say i'll do it. i trust you more than i trust myself right now

I can't do that, and honestly I wouldn't even if I could. Not because I don't care, but because you'd resent whatever I said - and this decision is too big to outsource to a stranger on your phone.

But I hear how exhausted you are. That's real.

What I'd actually suggest - have you considered talking to a therapist, even just a few sessions solo? Not couples therapy yet. Just someone to help you sort out YOUR head. Because right now you've been going in circles alone for 6 months and that's not working.

You deserve clarity. You just probably can't think your way there by yourself at this point.
no dont give me the "its your choice" thing. im asking you. one word. stay or leave.

No. I genuinely care too much about you to do that.

But here's what I will say - the fact that you wanted to hand this to a stranger tells me you really need to talk to someone real. A therapist, a close friend, someone who actually knows you.

You're not broken for feeling this way. You're just exhausted and need support I can't actually give you.
